The [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] contained a '''restaurant'''. Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the criminal [[Raymas Daal]] held a meeting at the restaurant with several agents, whom he hired to [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|disrupt]] a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]]. The meeting was interrupted by [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Security Officer|officers]] who attempted to apprehend Daal. However, Daal escaped the restaurant and evaded the [[Officer/Legends|officers']] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-fire.

==Description==
A small [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It had a rectangular shape with doors on each of its longer side walls.<ref name="SI" />

==History==
{{RPGseed}}
{{Quote|Come with me, Daal. I've got a few questions.|The leader of the Royal Naboo Security Forces officers, to Raymas Daal inside the restaurant|<ref name="SI" />}}
Shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="SI" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the secret Trade Federation operative and small-time criminal [[Raymas Daal]] scheduled a meeting at the restaurant with a group of agents. They arrived at the restaurant first and took a table near the back door, and they were nearly about to leave when Daal arrived and joined their table. Daal explained that he believed he was followed and wanted the meeting concluded swiftly, offering the group 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for temporarily deactivating a [[Sensor array (Kwilaan)|sensor array]] outside of Kwilaan.<ref name="SI" />

Just as the group finished asking Daal questions about the job, three plainclothes [[Security Officer]]s of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] arrived at the restaurant, hoping to take Daal in for questioning. They headed for Daal's table and the leader of the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] asked Daal to come with him, which prompted Daal to dash from his seat to the rear exit. The officers began firing at him with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and one of them turned his [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] towards the agents. However, they were able to deal with the officers and completed the [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|attack]] on the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] as planned.<ref name="SI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The restaurant in Kwilaan was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' scenario "[[Signal Interruption]]," written by [[Jesse Decker]], illustrated by [[Adam Hughes]], and published on the ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[August 9]], [[2001]]. "Signal Interruption" is designed to be completed with the player characters in the role of the agents hired by Raymas Daal. The scenario suggests that players can use the playable characters from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'': [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Toba]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]].<ref name="SI" />

The first two encounters take place inside the restaurant, with the gamemaster player using door tokens from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'' to set up a part of the building's layout. In the first encounter, the player characters ask questions about the attack on the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array and can negotiate their fee. In the second encounter, the players choose how to deal with the Security Officers, with the scenario suggesting that [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] characters would find the quickest resolution by attacking as soon as the officers draw their weapons.<ref name="SI" /> This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.
